# Source register

Every source document behind this playbook, what it is, and where its text lives in this repo. Each file under `sources/` opens with a header (where the original lives, its dates, when it was copied, why it is here) followed by the full text.

**The original document is the record. The repo is a mirror.** Black Fox Studios keeps its working documents in Google Drive. When one changes, copy its text here again and update the header date. Do not edit a mirror on its own.

A document's date is when an idea was recorded, not when it started.

## Adding a source

1. Copy the document's full text into a new file under `sources/<topic>/`, named in plain words.
2. Start the file with the header block used above: original title, where it lives, document id (an id only, no private sharing links), the date written inside it, the Drive dates, the copy date, what it is, why it is here, and reading notes.
3. Check the text before committing. **This repository is public.** No client names, personal details, private links, account numbers or anything not meant for any reader.
4. Add a row to this register and link the file from the chapter it supports.

## Related repos

This layout (a `sources/` folder plus this register) follows the source register in [Devhouse_Bodies_KnowBody](https://github.com/Cloudenvy7/Devhouse_Bodies_KnowBody/blob/main/docs/SOURCES.md), the pattern origin. That repository is private, so the link opens only for people with access.
